content: Anvi Desai called insurance agent Ravi Menon to confirm her refund amount of ₹12,450, check on paperwork requirements, inquire about loyalty discounts for a future policy, and confirm if she would receive an SMS notification upon refund credit. Ravi confirmed the details, stated that no further paperwork is needed, explained the 10-15 business day timeline for the refund, confirmed a 5% loyalty discount for future policies, and verified an SMS confirmation will be sent.
